approved_translation: Loyalty and gratitude are remembered; do not forget those who cared for you.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a rich man gave a baby Elephant to a woman. She took the best of care of this great baby and soon became very fond of him. "Oh, Blackie, Blackie," said Granny, "how hard you must have worked to earn these pieces of silver! What a good Blackie you are!" And after that Blackie did all the hard work and Granny rested, and they were both very happy.
